# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::kivvi=1.1.0

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process KIVVI {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/e7/e7fd42f324e6d2711bf04f023e7a50494bb96d20b440cb410402e2ea7f4e707f/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/kivvi:1.1.0--0ab7895bae051106'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bam), path(bai)
    val command

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.kivvi.*.json")   , emit: json
    tuple val(meta), path("*.kivvi.*.vcf")    , emit: vcf
    tuple val(meta), path("*.kivvi.*.svg")    , emit: svg, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.kivvi.*.bam")    , emit: bam
    tuple val(meta), path("*.kivvi.*.bam.bai"), emit: bai
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('kivvi'), eval("kivvi --version | sed 's/.* //g'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_kivvi

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def threads = command == "d4z4" ? "--threads ${Math.min(task.cpus as int, 2)}" : ""
    """
    kivvi \\
        $args \\
        --prefix ${prefix} \\
        --out ./ \\
        --bam $bam \\
        $command \\
        $threads
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.kivvi.${command}.json
    touch ${prefix}.kivvi.${command}.vcf
    touch ${prefix}.kivvi.${command}.svg
    touch ${prefix}.kivvi.${command}.bam
    touch ${prefix}.kivvi.${command}.bam.bai
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/kivvi"
description: "Calls copy number and sequence variants in large-unit variable number\
  \ tandem repeats from PacBio HiFi reads"
keywords:
- "kivvi"
- "genotyper"
- "tandem repeat"
- "vntr"
- "hifi"
tools:
- kivvi:
    description: "HiFi-based genotyper for large-unit VNTRs including KIV2 and D4Z4"
    homepage: "https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/kivvi"
    documentation: "https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/kivvi/blob/main/README.md"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/kivvi"
    doi: "10.64898/2026.04.10.717730"
    licence:
    - "Pacific Biosciences Software License (https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/kivvi/blob/main/LICENSE.md)"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "BAM file containing PacBio HiFi whole-genome reads aligned to\
        \ GRCh38,\nor a subset covering the target KIV2 or D4Z4 regions\n"
      pattern: "*.bam"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - bai:
      type: "file"
      description: "BAI index file corresponding to the BAM file\n"
      pattern: "*.bai"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2573"
- command:
    type: "string"
    description: "The command used to run the tool, i.e. kiv2 (LPA KIV2 repeat) or\
      \ d4z4 (D4Z4 repeat)"
output:
  json:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.kivvi.*.json':
        type: "file"
        description: "JSON report containing genotyping results for the target KIV2\
          \ or D4Z4 region"
        pattern: "*.kivvi.*.json"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3464"
  vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.kivvi.*.vcf':
        type: "file"
        description: "Variant calls for the target KIV2 or D4Z4 region"
        pattern: "*.kivvi.*.vcf"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  svg:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.kivvi.*.svg':
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional SVG visualisation of genotyping results for the target\
          \ KIV2 or D4Z4 region"
        pattern: "*.kivvi.*.svg"
        ontologies: []
  bam:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.kivvi.*.bam':
        type: "file"
        description: "Reads realigned to a single repeat unit of the target KIV2 or\
          \ D4Z4\nregion, with HP tags identifying repeat copies\n"
        pattern: "*.kivvi.*.bam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  bai:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.kivvi.*.bam.bai':
        type: "file"
        description: "BAI index file corresponding to the realigned BAM file"
        pattern: "*.kivvi.*.bam.bai"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2573"
  versions_kivvi:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - kivvi:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - kivvi --version | sed 's/.* //g':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - kivvi:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - kivvi --version | sed 's/.* //g':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@sofiademmou"
maintainers:
- "@sofiademmou"

  docker:
    linux/amd64:
      name: "community.wave.seqera.io/library/kivvi:1.1.0--0ab7895bae051106"
      build_id: "bd-0ab7895bae051106_1"
      scan_id: "sc-ad3d1b149c0da9d7_2"
  singularity:
    linux/amd64:
      name: "oras://community.wave.seqera.io/library/kivvi:1.1.0--fd0e9004280a5067"
      build_id: "bd-fd0e9004280a5067_1"
